title: Birthday Floral Backdrop
desc: A wild-garden birthday backdrop: airy asparagus fern and willow branches sweeping across a white panel, dotted with lilac hydrangea, purple larkspur, cream daisies and yellow accent blooms.

groups.label: Focal Flowers
groups.blurb: Lilac and purple accents with soft cream daisies.

items.role: Round lilac hydrangea heads anchoring the lower clusters.
Soft purple larkspur spikes rising through the greens.
White branching larkspur lightening the composition.
Cream daisies with yellow centres scattered at the base (matches the yellow-centre white-edge daisy request).

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Small purple mist-flowers and trailing beads.

items.role: Purple forget-me-not sprays standing in for the small purple mist-flowers.
Beaded trailing branches echoing the hanging strands (yellow-green tone; no green variant — noted).

groups.label: Foliage & Line Grasses
groups.blurb: The airy, sweeping greenery that defines this look.

items.role: Large fluffy asparagus fern sweeps — the signature airy mass of this backdrop.
Fine-leaf eucalyptus stems through the mid layer.
Reed grass plumes adding fine vertical line.
Light-green willow branch with fine leaves for the sweeping line accents.
Foxtail soft trailing grass woven through the corners.
